programme.desc: Dave faces a tricky residential lift, J.P. races between last-minute jobs, and Brad and Nathan Moore help a family’s dream come true.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Bridging the Gap"
programme.desc: Nathan battles strong winds on a big roofing job, Dave handles an easy lift, J.P. moves a hot tub, and Dan faces confusion on a bridge build.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Special Delivery"
programme.desc: Regional Crane’s new machine hits a hydraulic snag. Dave uses his downtime for repairs, and Brad helps clear a stand of pine trees.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "The Need for Speed"
programme.desc: Maxum Crane tackles a tight indoor lift, JP removes a 60-year-old fighter jet, and Brad and Nathan race to install farm machinery before a storm hits.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Day or Night"

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Ticket to Ride"

programme.desc: Emma meets Dr. Asad Khan, whose life was upended by long COVID, as new research seeks answers for millions still suffering worldwide.

programme.desc: Emma Keeling treks through Romania’s Tarcu Mountains to see how European bison, once extinct in the wild, are making a comeback.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - ""The Way" to Fusion"
programme.desc: Neil Cairns visits ITER in France, where nuclear fusion could provide unlimited clean energy, to see progress and challenges firsthand.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Urban Microbiome"
programme.desc: Research shows sanitized cities reduce beneficial microbes, harming health and increasing allergies and autoimmune diseases.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Future of Space Medicine"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli explores the future of space medicine and how we may overcome the challenges ahead.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Tales of the Cosmos"
programme.desc: Astronauts from the last five decades share stories of their adventures.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "How Spacecraft Missions End"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli speaks to NASA scientists at the heart of these decisions.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Unique Space Jobs"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli gets an inside look at some of the coolest jobs in the space industry.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Extreme Labs"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli boards the world’s largest flying observatory, dives to an underwater habitat, and explores a laboratory nearly a mile underground.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Mercury or Bust"
programme.desc: The ESA - JAXA joint Bepi-Colombo Mission is moments away from launch. The target is Mercury which has been too long neglected; this mission will shed new light on this strange world of light and dark.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Hyabusa2"
programme.desc: The Japanese Asteroid sample return mission has reached its target and is surveying the space rock ready to dip down and take a sample. The return of asteroid material to Earth will aid scientists in the evolving asteroid planetary defense systems.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Eyes to the Heavens"
programme.desc: Two new space telescopes are in orbit and completing their shakedown; Gaia and TESS they too will be joined by the James Webb Telescope. Together they will be opening up a whole new vista into time and space.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Martian Attractions"
programme.desc: The Latest in Martian exploration from orbit and on the ground, new sources of water and planetary dust storms are a few of the stories unfolding on to the Red Planet.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Typhoo Tea and Fox's biscuits"
programme.desc: In search of the classic British pairing, tea and biscuits, Lord Prescott travels to Liverpool to visit the Typhoo tea factory, discovering the key to a perfectly brewed cup. Back in Yorkshire, he stops by the Fox’s biscuits factory, rounding off his journey with a truly British treat.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Ribena and Tyrells"
programme.desc: Taking a nostalgic journey to rediscover two of his childhood favourites, Lord Prescott visits the Ribena factory to see how their famous blackcurrant squash is made, using 90% of the UK's blackcurrant crop. In Herefordshire, he explores the Tyrrells crisp factory to learn how a small farm-based business turns homegrown potatoes into gourmet crisps.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An Assault Rifle, a Bomb Suit, a Mortar, and a Zodiac"
programme.sub-title: An Assault Rifle, a Bomb Suit, a Mortar, and a Zodiac
programme.desc: What starts off as a seven-pound bar of solid steel will soon deliver a bullet with deadly accuracy when it becomes the barrel of a Colt C7 assault rifle, and when plastic and bulletproof fabric are molded and stitched together,they’ll make a suit of armour made for the most dangerous job in the world.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Parajet, a Hovercraft, a Camo Jacket, and a Portable Military Shelter"
programme.sub-title: A Parajet, a Hovercraft, a Camo Jacket, and a Portable Military Shelter
programme.desc: As lightweight aluminum is cut and tooled, it will become the frame of a personal flying machine. Used by military operatives, drug enforcement agents, and first responders – it gets you in and out fast, whether you are carrying a camera or a gun.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Sniper Rifle, a Zeppelin, a Ka-Bar Knife, and Dragon Eggs"
programme.sub-title: A Sniper Rifle, a Zeppelin, a Ka-Bar Knife, and Dragon Eggs
programme.desc: In 48 hours, a block of metal will be formed into the most accurate weapon on earth: the AX-338 Sniper Rifle. In a warzone, police stand off, or hostage taking, the sniper is often the only solution to a bad situation.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft"
programme.sub-title: An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft
programme.desc: When a steel plated hull is fitted with controls on the inside and tracks on the outside, it’ll become the Viking BVS10 –an armoured amphibious personnel carrier that can get troops in and out of any combat zone, even if it has to go through snow, sand, or water to get there.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED"
programme.sub-title: A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED
programme.desc: When a series of delicate snowflake shaped sheets of Aramid are pressed together, they’ll form a piece of headgear that’s comfortable enough to wear to war, and tough enough to take a bullet.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle"
programme.sub-title: A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle
programme.desc: At the Cabot factory in Pennsylvania, USA, a block of steel will be transformed by innovation and artistry into the ultimate update of an American classic. The 1911 did tours of duty in both world wars and Vietnam, and is still prized today by collectors and enthusiasts.
